positions.title: Student Lead
positions.description:
As a Student Leader, I was in charge of: 
- Running the shifts at the Farrand Market Dining Hall
- I managed employees
- Trained employees
- Handled customer complaints
- Prepared food
- Served food
- Ran cash-register
- Counted and reported earnings
- Cleaned the store
- Stocked shelves
- Locked up at nights.

positions.title: Delivery Driver
positions.description:
As a Delivery Driver my duties included:
 - taking phone orders in the store
- assisting in making pizzas
- prepping food
- handling carry-out orders
- using the register POS system to input orders
- deliver orders
- do dishes
- take out the trash
- sweep and mop floors
- work ovens
- cut and box pizza
- assemble orders
